pdf.methodology_text: SafeScan performs local triage of visible Android settings, package metadata, boot properties and security configuration. Results are snapshots and must be assessed in context.
pdf.forensic_limitation: A regular Android app cannot definitively detect or exclude advanced spyware or SS7 abuse. Use AndroidQF/MVT when there is concrete suspicion.

forensics.guide:
AndroidQF + MVT (permission required)

Before starting: install ADB, Python and AndroidQF on the computer. Enable USB debugging temporarily and accept the computer.

Linux: ./forensics/install-and-scan.sh
Windows: ./forensics/install-and-scan.ps1

Type YES. AndroidQF collects; MVT analyses. The scan removes nothing.
threat.title: Extended threat guide
threat.intro: SafeScan detects settings and known traces, but cannot rule out new zero-days or provider compromise.

advice.default_report: Review whether this setting or app was intentional. Record anomalies and avoid rushed changes.
report.priority.high: Handle all high-risk findings first. Disable unknown remote control and administration rights and install security updates.
report.priority.warning: Review all warnings and confirm every permission and administration app is intentional.
report.priority.safe: There are no immediate high-risk findings, but keep installing updates and repeat the check regularly.
